_comment: Migration approach rules for each web part category produced by analyze-aspx-webparts.ps1. Edit approach values before running analyse_aspx_content.py. Valid approaches: directly-convertible | replace-ootb | custom-exception

webPartRules.notes: Standalone list views map directly. Connected consumer web parts (filtered by row selection) have no OOTB SPO equivalent — mark NOT_MIGRATED and design detail-page separately.
List forms are auto-generated in SPO. These pages typically do not need to be migrated as modern pages — the SPO list's built-in NewForm/EditForm/DispForm replaces them.

webPartRules.modernEquivalent: Text web part or Embed web part
webPartRules.notes: Plain HTML/text → Text web part. If it contains custom JavaScript, evaluate whether the JS is still needed in SPO before converting.

webPartRules.modernEquivalent: SPFx web part (requires justification and approval)
webPartRules.notes: Script Editor is blocked in modern SPO. Any SEWP with business-critical JavaScript must be rebuilt as a reviewed and approved SPFx component.
Link collections map to Quick Links. Review link targets for broken URL remediation.

webPartRules.modernEquivalent: Quick links web part or page anchor links
webPartRules.notes: Auto-generated TOC has no direct SPO equivalent. Rebuild as Quick Links or remove if navigation provides sufficient structure.
Direct equivalent exists. Ensure image asset URLs are updated as part of link remediation.
Modern Embed web part can iframe external content. On-prem URLs embedded here will be unreachable from SPO — review each URL.

webPartRules.modernEquivalent: File viewer or Stream web part
webPartRules.notes: Depends on the media type and where it is hosted. Evaluate per instance.

webPartRules.modernEquivalent: SPFx web part (requires justification and approval)
webPartRules.notes: Sandbox solutions are completely blocked in SPO. Requires full SPFx rewrite. Must be explicitly justified with cost and support plan.

webPartRules.modernEquivalent: Planner web part or remove (tasks not used)
webPartRules.notes: SP2016 My Tasks is not present in modern SPO. Evaluate whether task tracking is actually used before deciding to replace.
Unrecognised web part type. Must be identified and classified manually before migration proceeds.

dispositionHints.ListForm: Keep — SPO list form auto-generated, no page migration needed
dispositionHints.RootPage: Review — evaluate whether this portal/default page has content worth migrating
dispositionHints.CustomForm: Review — may be a custom workflow form; check if workflow is still active
dispositionHints.SitePage: Review — apply Keep/Merge/Archive/Delete disposition manually based on content value
